mission: Test Suite Strategic Recovery - 8-Week Production Readiness Initiative

tasks.title: Diagnose main branch CI failures
tasks.description: Investigate why 'Update Backlog' workflow is failing on GitHub main (5 consecutive failures). Analyze workflow files, permissions, and backlog format. Identify root cause and document fix strategy.
acceptance_criteria: Root cause identified (workflow file, permissions, or backlog format)
Fix strategy documented with specific file changes
No side effects on other workflows verified

tasks.title: Fix main CI workflow
tasks.description: Apply fix for 'Update Backlog' workflow failure. May require workflow file changes, backlog format updates, or GitHub Action permissions adjustments.
acceptance_criteria: Workflow runs successfully on main branch
No breaking changes to backlog functionality

tasks.title: Validate CI fix with integration test
tasks.description: Create integration test for backlog workflow to prevent future CI failures. Test should validate workflow trigger conditions, catch invalid backlog markdown, and run in <10s.

tasks.title: Create PR for local commits
tasks.description: Push 4 local commits to GitHub and create PR for fix/test-suite-top-3-blockers branch. Commits: (1) fix 100% pass rate, (2) orchestrator/ML fixes, (3) audit docs, (4) config updates. Link to audit documents in PR description.

tasks.title: Merge all open PRs to main
tasks.description: Sequentially merge PRs to main after CI validation: (1) PR #90 branch protection docs, (2) PR #91 Tiered Spec Review, (3) new PR test suite fixes. Validate no merge conflicts, CI green after each merge, all tests passing on main.
acceptance_criteria: Main branch CI green after each merge

phases.title: Phase 1: P0 Blockers #1-2 - NECESSARY Markers + Coverage (Week 1)

tasks.title: Spec NECESSARY marker strategy
tasks.description: Design auto-classification strategy to apply NECESSARY markers to 5,804 existing tests. Define classification rules for 7 categories (Normal, Edge, Security, Spec, Accessibility, Resilience, Year-round). Use AST-based heuristics with confidence scoring. Create spec-033.
acceptance_criteria: Classification rules for all 7 NECESSARY categories

tasks.title: Implement NECESSARY classifier
tasks.description: Build Python script to auto-classify and apply NECESSARY markers using AST parsing. Script should parse all 292 test files, apply markers via AST rewriting, preserve existing decorators, generate classification report, support dry-run mode.
acceptance_criteria: Script parses all 292 test files successfully
Applies markers via AST rewriting (preserves syntax)
Generates classification report with confidence scores

tasks.title: Test NECESSARY classifier
tasks.description: Validate NECESSARY classifier accuracy and safety with 20+ tests covering all 7 marker categories, edge cases (empty files, malformed syntax, existing markers), and performance (<5s for 5,804 files).
acceptance_criteria: Edge cases covered (empty files, malformed syntax, existing markers)

tasks.title: Apply NECESSARY markers to test suite
tasks.description: Execute classifier on entire test suite (5,804 tests, 292 files). Run dry-run first, review report, create git checkpoint, apply markers, validate syntax with pytest --collect-only, ensure 100% pass rate maintained.
acceptance_criteria: All 5,804 tests marked with NECESSARY categories
All tests still pass (100% pass rate maintained)

tasks.title: Spec code coverage strategy
tasks.description: Design pytest-cov integration with coverage gates and CI integration. Define target coverage (70% baseline, 85% goal), exclusion rules, CI/CD integration strategy, coverage report format. Create spec-034.
acceptance_criteria: Target coverage percentage defined (70% baseline, 85% goal)
Coverage report format selected (HTML, terminal, XML)

tasks.title: Install and configure pytest-cov
tasks.description: Install pytest-cov, configure coverage settings in pyproject.toml, integrate with run_tests.py (add --coverage flag), create .coveragerc exclusion rules, update .gitignore for coverage artifacts.

tasks.title: Test coverage integration
tasks.description: Validate coverage integration works correctly with tests for report generation, HTML output, and baseline coverage >70%.
acceptance_criteria: Coverage report generated after test run

tasks.title: Generate initial coverage report
tasks.description: Run full test suite with coverage, analyze results, create analysis document (docs/test-coverage-baseline-2025-10-17.md), identify top 10 uncovered critical files, prioritize coverage improvements for Phase 2.

phases.title: Phase 2: P0 Blockers #3-4 - /primeccc E2E + Article IV (Week 2)

tasks.title: Spec /primeccc E2E test strategy
tasks.description: Design comprehensive E2E test plan for /primeccc autonomous orchestration workflow. Cover 7 workflow steps (auto-select, generate graph, validate, execute, verify, PR, learning). Define 20+ test scenarios, test data fixtures, mock strategy, performance targets. Create spec-035.
acceptance_criteria: 20+ E2E test scenarios (happy path + edge cases)
Mock strategy for expensive operations (GitHub API, LLM calls)
Performance targets (<5 min per E2E test)

tasks.title: Create /primeccc E2E test fixtures
tasks.description: Build realistic test fixtures for E2E /primeccc workflow. Create 5+ backlog fixtures (simple, moderate, complex), mocks for external services (GitHub, OpenAI), reusable fixtures across E2E tests.

tasks.title: Implement /primeccc E2E tests (happy path)
tasks.description: Build 10 happy-path E2E tests for core /primeccc functionality. Tests: auto-select from backlog, parallel execution, PR creation, task graph validation, phase completion, VectorStore learning, cost tracking, TodoWrite integration, checkpoint handling, error recovery.

tasks.title: Test /primeccc E2E happy path
tasks.description: Validate E2E happy path tests are correctly implemented and passing. Meta-tests for test count, fixture usage, timeout protection.

tasks.title: Implement /primeccc E2E tests (edge cases)
tasks.description: Build 10 edge-case E2E tests for failure scenarios and boundary conditions. Tests: empty backlog, circular dependency, agent failure retry, invalid task graph, budget exceeded, timeout handling, partial completion recovery, conflicting PRs, VectorStore unavailable, checkpoint rejection.

tasks.title: Test /primeccc E2E edge cases
tasks.description: Validate edge-case tests are robust. Verify edge cases caught and handled gracefully, coverage improvement documented.
acceptance_criteria: Edge cases caught and handled gracefully

tasks.title: Spec Article IV VectorStore enforcement
tasks.description: Design strategy to enforce Article IV (VectorStore mandatory) in test suite. Current issue: tests disable with USE_ENHANCED_MEMORY=false. Propose solution: constitutional gate pytest plugin, separate test modes (unit optional, integration required, E2E mandatory), memory assertions. Create spec-036.
acceptance_criteria: Test mode classification (unit vs integration vs E2E)

tasks.title: Implement Article IV enforcement plugin
tasks.description: Build pytest plugin to enforce VectorStore usage in E2E/integration tests. Plugin activates for E2E/integration markers, unit tests unaffected, clear error message on violation.
acceptance_criteria: Clear error message on Article IV violation

tasks.title: Test Article IV enforcement
tasks.description: Validate Article IV enforcement plugin works correctly. Tests: enforcement for E2E, unit tests allowed, clear error messages.

tasks.title: Enable VectorStore in CI for E2E tests
tasks.description: Update CI workflows to enable VectorStore for E2E/integration test runs. Modify .github/workflows/test.yml to set USE_ENHANCED_MEMORY=true for E2E tests.
acceptance_criteria: CI enables VectorStore for E2E tests
All E2E tests pass in CI

phases.title: Phase 3: P1 Gaps - Agent Comm + Memory + Constitutional (Weeks 3-4)

tasks.title: Spec agent communication test strategy
tasks.description: Design comprehensive test plan for 10 agents communication patterns. Current: 5 tests for 10 agents (inadequate). Target: 50 tests (10 agents × 5 comm patterns). Patterns: handoff, context sharing, error propagation, parallel coordination, sequential chaining.
acceptance_criteria: Communication patterns documented (handoff, context, error, parallel, sequential)

tasks.title: Implement agent communication tests
tasks.description: Build 50 agent communication tests covering all 10 agents and 5 patterns. Tests should validate handoff correctness, context preservation, error propagation, parallel coordination, sequential chaining.

tasks.title: Test agent communication tests
tasks.description: Validate agent communication tests are comprehensive and correct. Meta-tests for coverage, performance, edge cases.

tasks.title: Spec memory architecture E2E tests
tasks.description: Design E2E test plan for three-tier memory architecture (Anthropic Memory Tool, VectorStore, Session). Current: Anthropic Memory Tool untested. Target: 20 E2E tests covering create, view, edit, delete, search, persistence.

tasks.title: Implement memory architecture tests
tasks.description: Build 20 memory architecture E2E tests. Tests: create/view/edit/delete files, search across tiers, persistence validation, security (sandbox escape, path traversal), performance (<5s per operation).

tasks.title: Test memory architecture tests
tasks.description: Validate memory architecture tests are comprehensive. Meta-tests for coverage, security, performance.

tasks.title: Spec constitutional enforcement tests
tasks.description: Design automated enforcement tests for Articles III-V. Current: Articles I-II covered, III-V minimal. Target: 30 tests (10 per article). Article III: merge enforcement, quality gates, no bypass. Article IV: VectorStore mandatory, learning triggers. Article V: spec traceability, acceptance criteria.

tasks.title: Implement constitutional enforcement tests
tasks.description: Build 30 constitutional enforcement tests. Tests: Article III (merge blocks, quality gates, no bypass), Article IV (VectorStore required, learning auto-triggers), Article V (spec links, acceptance criteria).

tasks.title: Test constitutional enforcement tests
tasks.description: Validate constitutional enforcement tests are comprehensive. Meta-tests for coverage, violation detection, auto-healing.

tasks.title: Expand E2E workflow coverage
tasks.description: Double E2E test count from 29 to 58 tests. Add tests for: two-stage workflow, plan-only mode, graph execution, budget guard, slop immunity, completion validator, TodoWrite integration, learning extraction, ADR generation, PR creation.

tasks.title: Test E2E workflow expansion
tasks.description: Validate expanded E2E tests are comprehensive. Meta-tests for coverage, performance, edge cases.

phases.title: Phase 4: Production Hardening - Security + Stress + Bloat (Weeks 5-8)

tasks.title: Spec security testing strategy
tasks.description: Design penetration testing strategy for Agency OS. Current: 7 security tests (minimal). Target: 50 tests. Categories: auth bypass, injection (SQL, command, code), CSRF, XSS, path traversal, privilege escalation, secrets exposure, rate limiting.
acceptance_criteria: Penetration testing tools integrated (OWASP ZAP, Bandit)

tasks.title: Implement security tests
tasks.description: Build 50 security tests covering 8 attack categories. Tests: auth bypass, injection, CSRF, XSS, path traversal, privilege escalation, secrets exposure, rate limiting. Use OWASP ZAP and Bandit.
acceptance_criteria: Integration with security tools (OWASP ZAP, Bandit)

tasks.title: Test security tests
tasks.description: Validate security tests are comprehensive. Meta-tests for coverage, severity classification, tool integration.

tasks.title: Spec stress testing strategy
tasks.description: Design load and stress testing strategy. Current: no load tests. Target: 20 tests. Scenarios: 1000 concurrent tasks, memory profiling, CPU profiling, network latency, database contention, cache invalidation, worker pool exhaustion.

tasks.title: Implement stress tests
tasks.description: Build 20 stress tests. Tests: 1000 concurrent tasks, memory profiling, CPU profiling, network latency simulation, database contention, cache invalidation, worker pool exhaustion. Use locust for load generation.

tasks.title: Test stress tests
tasks.description: Validate stress tests are comprehensive. Meta-tests for performance baselines, crash detection, resource exhaustion.

tasks.title: Spec chaos engineering strategy
tasks.description: Design chaos engineering tests. Current: minimal. Target: 15 tests. Scenarios: network failures, agent crashes, partial failures, timeout cascades, retry storms, circuit breaker validation, graceful degradation.

tasks.title: Implement chaos engineering tests
tasks.description: Build 15 chaos tests. Tests: network failures, agent crashes, partial failures, timeout cascades, retry storms, circuit breaker, graceful degradation. Use chaos-monkey library.

tasks.title: Test chaos engineering tests
tasks.description: Validate chaos tests are comprehensive. Meta-tests for failure injection, recovery validation, resilience patterns.

tasks.title: Delete 200 bloated tests
tasks.description: Execute bloat cleanup following TEST_SUITE_CLEANUP_CHECKLIST.md. Delete 200 tests in batches (50 at a time). Tests: test_chief_architect_agent_simple.py (entire file), 12 'not implemented' stubs, 20 high-mock tests from test_chief_architect_agent.py, duplicates, redundant.
acceptance_criteria: 100% pass rate maintained after each batch

tasks.title: Refactor time.sleep() mocking
tasks.description: Mock time.sleep() in 69 tests to save 89s runtime. Primary targets: test_chaos_testing.py (12 tests), test_memory_cache.py (9 tests), test_distributed_locks.py (9 tests). Use monkeypatch or freezegun.

tasks.title: Parametrize duplicate tests
tasks.description: Parametrize redundant tests to reduce duplication. Targets: test_bash_pydantic_validation.py (40 tests → 10 parametrized), test_git_validation.py (similar). Use pytest.mark.parametrize.

tasks.title: Generate ADR-032 (8-Week Recovery)
tasks.description: Generate comprehensive ADR documenting 8-week test suite recovery initiative. Include: context (audit findings), decision (phased approach), consequences (metrics improvement), alternatives considered, constitutional alignment, lessons learned.

tasks.title: Update test architecture documentation
tasks.description: Update all test architecture documentation to reflect 8-week improvements. Documents: TEST_ARCHITECTURE_ACTION_PLAN.md, constitution.md (Articles III-V enforcement), CLAUDE.md (testing guidelines), README.md (test suite metrics).

tasks.title: Final validation and handoff
tasks.description: Execute final validation: full test suite run (100% pass), coverage validation (≥85%), security audit (no critical), stress tests (no crashes), grade calculation (≥95/100 = A grade). Generate handoff report.

checkpoints.prompt: Review Phase 0 completion: Main branch CI green, all PRs merged, clean git state. Approve Phase 1-2 execution (Weeks 1-2)?
Review Phase 1 completion: NECESSARY markers applied (5,804 tests), code coverage baseline (≥70%). Approve Phase 2 execution (Week 2)?
Review Phase 2 completion: /primeccc E2E tests (20 tests), Article IV enforced. Approve Phase 3 execution (Weeks 3-4)?
Review Phase 3 completion: Agent comm tests (50), memory tests (20), constitutional tests (30), E2E expansion (58). Approve Phase 4 execution (Weeks 5-8)?
Final validation: 100% pass rate, ≥85% coverage, no critical security issues, Final Grade A (95/100).
